[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Revelation (revelation-greek). The verses the casting arrives at (6:9–6:12):

**6:9** Καὶ ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν πέμπτην σφραγῖδα, εἶδον ὑποκάτω τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν ἐσφαγμένων διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ διὰ τὴν ⸀μαρτυρίαν ἣν εἶχον.

**6:10** καὶ ἔκραξαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγοντες· Ἕως πότε, ὁ δεσπότης ὁ ἅγιος καὶ ἀληθινός, οὐ κρίνεις καὶ ἐκδικεῖς τὸ αἷμα ἡμῶν ἐκ τῶν κατοικούντων ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς;

**6:11** καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς ἑκάστῳ στολὴ λευκή, καὶ ἐρρέθη αὐτοῖς ἵνα ⸀ἀναπαύσονται ἔτι χρόνον ⸀μικρόν, ἕως ⸀πληρωθῶσιν καὶ οἱ σύνδουλοι αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ⸀αὐτῶν οἱ μέλλοντες ⸀ἀποκτέννεσθαι ὡς καὶ αὐτοί.

**6:12** Καὶ εἶδον ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν σφραγῖδα τὴν ἕκτην, καὶ σεισμὸς μέγας ἐγένετο, καὶ ὁ ἥλιος ⸂ἐγένετο μέλας⸃ ὡς σάκκος τρίχινος, καὶ ἡ σελήνη ὅλη ἐγένετο ὡς αἷμα,

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «can we finally get this done?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The casting arrives here: beneath the altar, the slaughtered ones cry out — Ἕως πότε, *how long* — and are given white robes and told to wait a little longer, until the number is complete; then the sixth seal breaks and the sun goes black as sackcloth, the moon entire becomes blood. The question the witness brings — *can we finally get this done* — lands inside a text that has already asked it, in Greek, under an altar, in the voice of the dead. The rotation will traverse this: what the source's bearing forecloses in each turn, axis by axis — the cost of the cry, the symmetry the waiting destroys, the negative pole of the white robe, the creaturely substrate of sun and moon turned to grief-matter. We open the rotation without naming the first operator; the Judgment has already chosen. I hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:00D8"}}]}
